## Context / Problem
Discovered while triaging breezy-hogged-mastiff, which owns `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. These 15 entries move to `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/posix-api.args`, which this bug owns.

Signatures read in run 44681457334: `os.fork` absent (`tests/unit/grounding/test_harness.py`), `signal.SIGKILL` absent (`test_gate_admission_09da.py`), `select` on a pipe raises `WinError 10038` (`test_compact_trigger_shared_sidecars.py`, `test_recent_creates_shared_journal.py`), `os.stat_result.st_blocks` absent (`tests/unit/store/test_footprint.py`, `tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py` reports allocation `unavailable`), peak RSS is None without `resource` (`test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py`), POSIX mode bits not honoured (`test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py` 0o666 vs 0o600, `tests/scripts/test_ensure_pandoc.py` exec bit, `test_opcert_own_pub_resolution_d26a.py` read-only dir still writable), a subprocess lock holder that never takes its `fcntl` lock (`test_doctor_locks.py::test_a_contended_fcntl_leg_reads_as_held`, `test_git_contention_9305.py`), and an evicted snapshot directory still present while a reader holds it open (`test_snapshot_janitor.py`).

Evidence: Windows runs on throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` (origin/main `717c50f8b33` plus a selection-only workflow change): run 44665461131 and run 44681457334 (JUnit XML with full tracebacks), both 2026-11-19 PST. Per-test causes: ticket comment of 2026-11-21.

## Root cause
Product:
1. `src/rebar/_store/git_locking.py` imports `fcntl` itself (:34-37) and returns unlocked when it is absent (`_store_git_op_lock` :191, `fetch_coordination_lock`, `_acquire_fetch_coord_flock`). On Windows the per-store git-op lock (bug 9305) and the common-dir fetch lock are no-ops, although `src/rebar/_store/lock_kernel.py` has an `msvcrt` leg used by every other store lock.
2. `src/rebar/_proc.py` `reap_process_group` only calls `proc.kill()` off POSIX (`killpg` is POSIX-only), so a timed-out child's pipe-holding grandchild survives on Windows.
Test-side: `select.select` on a pipe, `signal.SIGKILL`, `os.fork`, `fcntl` in a child lock holder, `st_blocks` and exec-bit assertions with no Windows branch.

## Approach (this change)
- `git_locking`: take and release both locks through `lock_kernel.take_exclusive` / `release_exclusive`; a platform with neither leg (`NoExclusiveLegError`) still proceeds unlocked. Same bounded wait, same "advisory, proceed on exhaustion" contract. Drop the module's own `fcntl` import; `tests/unit/store/test_git_locking_no_fcntl.py` patches `lock_kernel.fcntl`/`msvcrt` instead.
- `_proc.reap_process_group` off POSIX: `taskkill /F /T /PID <pid>` (bounded by `grace + drain`) kills the child and its descendants, falling back to `proc.kill()` when taskkill is missing or fails; then `communicate(timeout=drain)` drains the pipes and logs a survivor, as on POSIX. POSIX path unchanged. No config key, env var or flag.
- Tests: `test_harness` grandchild via `subprocess.Popen` writing its pid, asserted dead after the timeout on every platform (liveness via `lock_owner._pid_alive`, never `os.kill(pid, 0)`, which terminates on Windows); a unit test pins the taskkill argv and the fallback. `test_compact_trigger_shared_sidecars` / `test_recent_creates_shared_journal` read the holder's line through a bounded reader thread. `test_gate_admission_09da` uses `holder.kill()`. `test_doctor_locks` and `test_git_contention_9305` holders lock through `lock_kernel`. `test_footprint` / `test_tracker_footprint_cli` expect the documented `unavailable` allocation where `os.stat_result` has no `st_blocks` (`footprint.py:26,70`). `test_ensure_pandoc` checks the exec bit only where POSIX mode bits exist.
- `test_opcert_own_pub_resolution_d26a::test_certifies_when_the_key_dir_is_read_only` skips on Windows ("chmod cannot make a Windows directory unwritable"); its line stays and is recorded here as intentionally unsupported.
- Remove the 9 fixed lines from `posix-api.args`.

## Not in this change (design decisions pending with the coordinator)
(a) janitor rename-first eviction with an open reader (`test_snapshot_janitor.py`, `janitor.py:211-214`); (b) peak RSS on Windows (3 `test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py` lines, `peak_rss.py:40`); (c) op-cert key ACL on Windows (`test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py`). Their 5 lines stay. This ticket stays in_progress until they are decided and done; it is not closed on this change.

## Scope
src/rebar/_store/git_locking.py, src/rebar/_store/lock_kernel.py (docstring caller list), src/rebar/_proc.py, tests/unit/test_proc_reap_windows.py (new), the 10 test modules named above, tests/unit/store/test_git_locking_no_fcntl.py, .github/windows-sweep-deselect/posix-api.args.

## Testing
Pre-merge: push the tree to `tmp/b5-aerial-flameproof-antbear`, dispatch `test.yml`, record the `sweep (windows)` run id, show each removed test was collected and the job had 0 failures among them; delete the branch. Post-merge: first scheduled main `test.yml` run containing the merge (AC1). `make verify` before push.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every line removed from `posix-api.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `posix-api.args` is empty and deleted with its reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, or each remaining line names a test recorded on this ticket as intentionally unsupported on Windows with the reason.
